properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real, address-tagged OpenStreetMap building footprint for Madrone, a two-tower Bosa Development luxury condominium complex (329-330 units per secondary sources, opened 2011-2012, architect Perkins & Will per secondary sources) sharing Assessor Block 8720 with its sister project Radiance. Point-in-polygon checked against DataSF's official 'Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas' layer (m288-24sn): this site falls in Mission Bay South, not Mission Bay North as this project's own brief informally grouped it -- corrected here against the authoritative boundary rather than the brief's casual wording. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: the parenthetical above is corrected: (1) '329-330 units per secondary sources' is withdrawn, since Bosa's page gives 693 units for Radiance, Madrone and Arden combined and nothing cited gives Madrone's own count; (2) 'opened 2011-2012' is overstated, since Bosa says only that Madrone's two connected 16-storey towers were completed 'a few years' after 2008, while the DataSF Assessor roll gives year_property_built 2012 for the per-unit lots at 420 and 480 Mission Bay Blvd N and 435 China Basin St and SocketSite (July 29, 2010) reported Radiance West move-in expected by mid-2012; (3) 'architect Perkins & Will per secondary sources' is withdrawn: no cited source names an architect; (4) the OSM tag is name=, not addr:housename= (the digitized_from field is fixed). 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same real-geometry-without-a-single-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.'. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8720117 (11,410 m2, active, mapped 2012-06-20); the earlier outline of 10,169 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.87 (99% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 88% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). The lot is condominium-mapped: 332 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8720117 and 331 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. geometry_type stays 'real'. properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8720117 (11,410 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 332 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8720117 and 331 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 142845124, name=Madrone Mission Bay, 480 Mission Bay Blvd N)); 99% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 88% of the lot.
properties.notes: Unit count and opening year are not established by any cited source: Bosa's project page gives 693 units for Radiance, Madrone and Arden combined and says only that Madrone's towers were completed 'a few years' after Radiance (2008); the Assessor roll gives year built 2012 for the condominium lots at 420 and 480 Mission Bay Blvd N and 435 China Basin St.
